question: An infinite number of charges, each of magnitude $q$, are placed on the x-axis at $x = a, x = ar, x = ar^2, \dots$ (where $r > 1$). The consecutive charges have opposite signs, starting with $+q$ at $x=a$. What is the magnitude of the net electric field at the origin?
